title: Client Impact Brief — Dual Track (Standard + Enterprise)
content:
Purpose:
This is a lightweight, dual-track QBR slide kit designed to let Customer Success managers run either a Compact (Standard) 20-minute customer check-in or a Deep-Dive (Enterprise) 60–75 minute executive review. The goal is to reduce prep friction, give consistent renewal signals, and provide a reusable renewal tracker that can be exported into the CRM or playbooks repo.

How to use (notes to CSMs):
- Pick track at least 10 business days before the meeting. Compact = product adoption + 3 action items. Deep-Dive = full metrics + roadmap + exec ask.
- Attach the filled renewal tracker CSV to the calendar invite and the Confluence QBR page.
- For Enterprise, include 10–15 minute pre-brief with account team to align ask and risks.

Slide flow (compact track — ~10 slides):
1) Title / Meeting objective (1 slide) — speaker note: set expectations (outcomes, timebox).
2) Quick health snapshot (1 slide) — 3 metrics: usage trend, tokens/day, error rate.
3) Top wins since last QBR (1 slide) — 3 bullets with short customer quotes.
4) Open issues / blockers (1 slide) — prioritized, owner, ETA.
5) Renewal health & risk score (1 slide) — scoring bands: Green/Yellow/Red, comments.
6) Quick roadmap ask (1 slide) — feature/integration ask, ask of customer.
7) Success plan + 3 next steps (1 slide) — owner and target dates.
8) Appendix: integration checklist & contact matrix (1 slide)
9) Appendix: quick playbook links & support path (1 slide)

Slide flow (deep-dive track — ~25 slides):
1) Executive summary (1 slide) — 3 bullet impact statement (cost, time-to-value, reliability).
2) Health dashboard (2–3 slides) — detailed graphs (latency P95, cost per 1k tokens, availability), speaker note: call out anomalies.
3) Adoption by product/team (1 slide) — seat-level or route-level adoption.
4) Usage segmentation (1 slide) — top prompts, peak windows, burst analysis.
5) Quality / regressions (2 slides) — evals, sample prompts, baseline comparison.
6) Incident postmortem highlights (1 slide) — RCA summary, mitigations.
7) Cost optimization opportunities (2 slides) — batching/quantization recommendations, expected $ savings.
8) Roadmap alignment (3 slides) — both Redwood roadmap items and customer asks; suggest canary plan.
9) Renewal & commercial items (2 slides) — timeline, ARR, seat/license health, expansion opportunities.
10) Risks & mitigation plan (1 slide) — dependency map, fallback plans.
11) Commitment & next steps (1 slide) — ask timeline, champions, exec sponsorship.
12) Appendix: detailed metrics export, raw logs instructions, runbook links (4–6 slides)

Renewal tracker (CSV template — include as inline table for quick copy/paste):
Account,ARR,Contract_end,Renewal_owner,Health_score,Top_risks,Expansion_opps,Next_action,Action_owner,ETA
Acme Corp,245000,2025-09-30,Aisha Patel,Yellow,Latency spikes in US-west,Embedding rollout $40k,Schedule exec sync,Aisha Patel,2025-02-28
Beta Solutions,120000,2025-05-15,Marco Ruiz,Green,No immediate risk,Platform training $15k,Deliver training plan,Customer Success,2025-03-10

Health scoring rubric (one-slide reference):
- Green (8–10): usage growth > 10% q/q, latency p95 < target, no open sev2/3 incidents, NPS > 40
- Yellow (5–7): flat usage, 1–2 operational actions required, upcoming contract within 90 days
- Red (0–4): declining usage, >=1 unresolved sev2/3, exec not engaged
Speaker note: annotate with evidence per metric (attach time-series exports).

Customizable callouts and templates inside the deck (placeholders to fill):
- [CUSTOMER_ONE_LINER_IMPACT] — 1 sentence ROI statement
- [TOP_TECH_RISKS] — 3 items with owner and mitigation
- [EXEC_ASK] — specific commercial or technical request, value to customer and Redwood

Measuring outcomes (KPI suggestions):
- Leading: weekly active routes, average tokens/route, drift in prompt latency
- Lagging: ARR delta, renewal outcome, time to resolution for sev2 incidents

Playbook snippets included in the notes area (copy/paste friendly):
- Pre-QBR checklist: confirm data exports, run churn model, schedule pre-brief with AE, prepare tailored roadmap slide.
- Post-QBR follow-up cadence: 48-hour summary email, 10-day progress check, 30-day executive progress brief.
- Escalation flow: if Health_score = Red => auto-create Jira CS-HighRisk ticket and schedule remediation sprint with SRE/Platform.

Deck variants guidance (how to trim/expand):
- Trim to compact: collapse detailed metrics into single "health dashboard" slide and move long tables to appendix.
- Expand to enterprise: add two appendix slides: 1) granular token cost waterfall, 2) sample prompt evals with annotations.

Quick speaker-script examples (for 2–3 slides):
- Exec Summary: "Since our last review, we helped reduce inference cost by ~12% for you, removed the highest latency tail, and validated embedding quality for your search index. Today we want to align on a roadmap item that will unlock 20% more queries without increasing cost."
- Renewal ask (compact): "We recommend a 12-month renewal to lock current pricing and enable the dedicated capacity discount — target decision by 2025-04-15."

Open questions / TODOs (notes to self):
- Add link to new billing export (finance still gating).
- Request example success story from SE team for Beta Solutions to include as win.
- Validate health score thresholds with product-ops.

Appendix (assets to attach when sharing):
- Exported metrics CSV (tokens_by_route.csv)
- Renewals tracker CSV (renewal-tracker.csv)
- Confluence QBR briefing page link
- Runbook links for incident handoff

Revision history (in-file):
- 2025-01-10: initial compact + deep-dive draft (Aisha)
- 2025-02-15: added renewal tracker template, health rubric, speaker scripts (Marco + Sofia)

Why this is different:
- Dual-track built to minimize prep for high-velocity accounts while giving an in-depth executive narrative for enterprise customers.
- Template focused on measurable, action-oriented outcomes (owner + ETA on every action).
- Explicit integration with CS tooling (Jira ticket hooks, exports) to reduce manual re-entry.

Contact for feedback: Aisha Patel — aisha.patel@redwood.ai (PM/CS lead)

Notes: keep this slide kit in the customer-success shared folder; update yearly and after major product/price changes.
